name: Rob Saemann
office: City of Hermosa Beach, Member of the City Council

items.text: Rob Saemann is a Hermosa Beach City Councilmember, first elected in 2022, and was mayor in 2025-26. A general contractor with 50 years of experience, he previously served on the Planning Commission and Public Works Commission. He supports the city’s half-cent sales tax measure. He says he made a motion in March 2026 to plan for pier replacement by 2032 using segmental construction to keep part open. He has proposed requiring license plates on faster e-bikes for identification. He asked to default residents into the lowest Clean Power Alliance tier. He voted to suspend complimentary holiday parking to save costs.
